description.text: This program is designed to turn out Inter-disciplinary mechatronical talents capable of dealing with mechatronical theorical research, mechatronical experiment and mechatronical engineering design and development. Major Courses : Engineering Mechanics,Basic Mechanical Design and Manufacturing, Basic Circuit Analysis, Electronic Technology, Computer Theory and Application, Mechanical Manufacturing and Automation, Automatic Control Theory, Signal and Systems, Digital Signal Processing, Automation Equipment, Electrical and Mechanical System Design, System Simulation , Sensing and Detection Technology.

duration.text: The Electronic Engineering at Nanjing University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: Applicant should hold high school graduation certificate with excellent performance and good health, and have valid foreign passport. Applicant should hold HSK level 3 certificate;
